checks.value: Item X. Executive Officers of the Registrant

provenance: T9 tranche 2 (INTERIM SARBANES-OXLEY NUMBERING stratum, second filing + SEMICOLON-LIST POINTER shape + non-calendar fiscal year). sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/27419/000104746903013199/a2105670z10-k.htm, accession 0001047469-03-013199, filed 2003-04-14, FY ending 2003-02-01, 89,583 bytes, HTML. AUTHORED FROM THE DOCUMENT, NOT FROM PIPELINE OUTPUT, and verified 2026-08-17 by an independent tag-strip scan importing nothing from src/: cover reads 'For the fiscal year ended February 1, 2003'; 'Item 14. Controls and Procedures.' and 'Item 15. Exhibits, Financial Statement Schedules, and Reports on Form 8-K.' each occur 2x (contents row + body); zero occurrences of 'Item 9A' or 'Item 9B'. Same interim regime as intc-2002 but a different sector, filing agent and fiscal calendar, and a period end two months later — the pair brackets the regime rather than sampling it once. WHY THIS FILING EARNS ITS PLACE BEYOND THE REGIME: (a) it is a nearly pure shell primary document — 33K normalized chars, with the substance in the Annual Report filed as exhibit 13 — so Part I and most of Part II are whole-item external pointers, the densest IBR filing in the set; (b) item 2's pointer sentence is a SEMICOLON LIST ('Leases, Page 32; Owned and Leased Store Locations, Page 32, and the list of store locations ... are incorporated herein by reference.'), and `_sentences` splits on ';' as if it ended a sentence, truncating the pointer before the words 'Annual Report to Shareholders' — the same failure family as the ADR-014 'Proposal No. 2' ordinal, one punctuation mark over. EXPECTED RED AT AUTHORING TIME (watched before any fix, hard rule 2): item 15 absent (era table), item 14 era-wrong label, item 2 `extracted` instead of `incorporated_by_reference`. ITEM 1 IS DELIBERATELY `extracted`, NOT IBR, AND THE DISTINCTION IS THE POINT: its body opens with the same semicolon-list pointer but then carries ~1,300 chars of real inline prose (state of incorporation, 306,000 employees, Competition, Available Information) — a MIXED item, `extracted` per ADR-010 ruling 3. A fix that flips item 2 must leave item 1 alone. OTHER STATUSES VERIFIED IN-DOCUMENT: items 3/5/6/7/8 are single-sentence pointers to the 2002 Annual Report to Shareholders; items 10/11 point to the Proxy Statement dated April 14, 2003; item 4 is 'Not Applicable.' followed by the registrant's unnumbered 'Item X. Executive Officers of the Registrant' chart (an out-of-taxonomy pseudo-item that must never surface as an item — the anchor pins it inside item 4's span); item 12 carries the Equity Compensation Plan Information table inline; items 9 and 13 are 'Not Applicable.' trivial bodies. doc_status is deliberately unpinned: item 15's 16,198-char exhibit block is 49% of this unusually small document, which sits at the edge of LAST_ITEM_MAX by arithmetic rather than by defect.
